evidence_class: local_integration on one WSL2 x86_64 host; one run per arm; isolated ai-memory servers on restored copies of a sealed store snapshot
question: Does the dense result hold through ai-memory's own hybrid retrieval (FTS5 + entity + graph + vector, RRF) as agents call it (MCP memory_query)?
queries: the merged Q1+Q2 set of the dense benchmark: 76 queries, 62 answerable

arms.A: ai-memory 2.3.2, local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (the configuration running before the change)
arms.A2: ai-memory 2.4.0 + prefix patch, local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (isolates the version change)
arms.B: ai-memory 2.4.0 + prefix patch, openai-compat Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 with query:/passage: prefixes, vLLM max-model-len 8192
arms.B4k: as B with max-model-len 4096 (the resident service's setting at the time)

results.pages_embedded: 121/130, 9 failures (context-length 400s, same 9 session pages c1's arm B also lost)

preregistered_rule: switch the embedder to B only if B's nDCG@10 is at least 0.03 above A's, B's top-5 hit rate is not lower, and B embeds 130/130 pages; if B4k fails a page that B does not, the resident service's max-model-len must be raised with the switch
rule_outcome: all three conditions met (nDCG@10 +0.078, top-5 hits 55/62 vs 53/62, 130/130); B4k embedded 121/130 (nine pages over 4096 tokens), so max-model-len 8192 is required; A2 equals A, so the version change alone has no effect

independent_verification.verdict: metrics and isolation confirmed; decision holds under the locked rule
independent_verification.retrieval_config: RRF k=60, equal lane weights, all four streams active in every arm
notes: protocol.lock was rewritten after arms A and A2 ran and the earlier locks were not kept; the order rests on file times and the command log
the command log was written by hand rather than by the logging wrapper
the prefix count was taken before the queries ran; the full request log shows 337/337 prefixed requests for B (260 passage, 77 query), none double-prefixed
no port audit file was kept; a later check found no temporary server bound and the resident services unchanged
the arm servers had an LLM provider configured for consolidation; no provider call appears in their logs and the setting was identical across arms

limits: 62 answerable queries; the top-5 hit difference is two queries
MCP round-trip latency includes a CLI process spawn per query
Q1 had one annotator; Q2 annotator 1 also wrote the queries.
